WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) AS s, MAX(calendar_date) AS e FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at, o.fulfilment_type, o.status,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
)
SELECT 'lines_by_store_nonweb' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl
FROM lines, (SELECT MIN(s) s, MAX(e) e FROM per) p WHERE dd BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND store_id <> 900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines_store900', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no))
FROM lines, (SELECT MIN(s) s, MAX(e) e FROM per) p WHERE dd BETWEEN p.s AND p.e AND store_id = 900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'period_'||CAST(fiscal_period AS VARCHAR)||'_'||CAST(s AS VARCHAR)||'_'||CAST(e AS VARCHAR), 0,0,0 FROM per

SELECT s.store_id, o.fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS returns, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS rpt_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross_of_returns, SUM(r.returns_net) AS rpt_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT r.business_date) AS days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
